title: xo work inbox (~/.quirq/work/inbox/inbox.json)
description: The decisions a person made on the Inbox page, each keyed by the fact it was about, and which connection kinds are decisions. Nothing from a log is copied here. Written by services/work/ and hand-editable: unknown keys survive a rewrite, a mark with a bad key or value is dropped on read.

connections.description: Connection kinds (toolkit.type) that are decisions; the default is empty.

dismissed.description: '<key>@<since>' -> when it was dismissed. The pair is what is hidden, so the same condition starting again comes back. Pruned after 30 days.

acked.description: '<key>' -> when a Completed row was acknowledged. Pruned after 30 days.

promoted.description: '<key>' -> the work item the entry became. Idempotent by key.
